scope: Initial per-system content discovery across the pinned full-x86 advertised catalog. Emulator/core mappings are retained, not individually qualified for these fixtures.

status_definitions.redistributable_candidate: A specific content lead has affirmative redistribution terms. This is not complete asset/dependency clearance, a ready-binary guarantee or a compatibility result; some grants impose restrictions.
status_definitions.source_only_candidate: Useful source/build lead found, but a complete qualified launchable artifact was not established. Some rows also have unresolved source or asset rights.
status_definitions.proprietary_prerequisite: The researched conventional path includes separately copyrighted firmware, operating-system/game data or restricted tooling. Free alternatives may exist but require backend/version qualification; application rights can also remain unresolved.
status_definitions.unresolved: No sufficiently qualified fixture established in this research. This is not evidence that none exists.
status_definitions.not_rom_applicable: A utility/media/launcher category or specifically ROM-free implementation; use a different kind of scenario rather than inventing a cartridge ROM.

limits: No ROM/firmware binary downloads, source builds, emulator execution, SSH or screenshots were performed during this research.
No row is final redistribution approval. Preserve code, linked dependency and asset terms separately.
An advertised system/core is not installed-binary or working-support evidence.
Many primary-source links describe current upstream rather than the exact packaged backend version; reconcile before selecting a test.
Dispositions summarize the leading constraint and are not mutually exclusive descriptions of all prerequisites.
Fixture discovery does not select required/conditional test tiers or authorize execution.

upstream_license_policy.boundary: Batocera contains mixed component licenses. Its team code is generally LGPL v3 unless upstream terms apply; additional game/art/firmware rights are separate.

systems.candidate: trapexit/3do-devkit community examples are an investigation lead, not an approved ROM. Original and reworked examples explicitly derive from historical 3DO SDK releases.
systems.license_scope: No complete source-plus-asset redistribution grant established for a selected example. Do not treat SDK availability or Opera's open code as licensing the SDK examples, Portfolio components, or system ROM.
systems.prerequisites: Opera requires one supported system BIOS, for example panafz1.bin or panafz10.bin. Kanji ROM is optional except for software that needs it. Content uses ISO/CUE/CHD. Devkit examples use bootstrap-3do-project and its build environment.
systems.caveats: No selected example has established visual/input behavior plus cleared assets and boot-disc production. SDK-origin examples require individual provenance review. No compatibility claim.

systems.candidate: devkitPro/3ds-examples graphics/printing/hello-world; prefer this text-only sample over examples using Nintendo system fonts or external media
systems.license_scope: The example repository README explicitly carries the Public Domain Mark 1.0. This is a public-domain assertion, not a CC0 fallback license. Treat it as evidence for the example source, and retain a copy of the assertion. Linked libctru/runtime licensing remains separate; no permission for Nintendo firmware, system titles or fonts follows from it.
systems.prerequisites: Build with devkitARM, libctru and the devkitPro build environment. Inspect the resulting ELF, which the pinned system advertises as accepted; its usual .3dsx output is not in the advertised extension list. Azahar's Artic Setup Tool installs system files and console-unique data from an owned 3DS. Whether this minimal ELF bypasses any of that setup remains untested, so do not classify all 3DS execution as firmware-free. Avoid encrypted retail formats and private keys in the shared content set.
systems.caveats: Public Domain Mark is weaker cross-jurisdiction evidence than an explicit permissive license with fallback. No compiled output, linked-library closure or Azahar setup behavior was verified. A homebrew sample is not evidence that proprietary system assets can be bundled.
